_scenario: United Kingdom. Microsoft 365 Apps installs with en-gb as its single UI language.
_notes: en-gb and en-us produce packages that look identical from the outside - same file name, similar size, same detection script. The difference is visible in exactly three places: the build banner (Language='en-gb'), section 7 of the generated Build\Output\M365Apps\M365Apps-IntuneConfig.md, and the client install log line 'Installing M365 Apps with languages: en-gb.'. Check one of them before you upload.
Because the two are indistinguishable at a glance, prefer this file over the -Language flag: the value is then applied to every build without having to be repeated.

The Language token applies to Microsoft 365 Apps only. Visio and Project base installs are always en-us regardless of what is set here; give them en-gb afterwards with a LanguagePack app (-TargetProduct VisioProRetail / ProjectProRetail), which the matrix does support for en-gb.
